{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "indexes",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies point-read error handling across all secondary index classes under src/index/ (txindex, coinstatsindex, blockfilterindex, txospenderindex).",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.4,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Centralizes index read failure handling so corrupted index reads trigger fatal error reporting rather than silently failing individual RPC queries while the node continues running with bad state. Reviewers note this changes node availability trade-offs for optional indexes by making corruption fatal."
    },
    {
      "name": "kernel",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/kernel/chainstatemanager_opts.h (+3/-0) only to pass error handling options, incidental to the validation refactoring.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Incidental update to kernel options structs following the validation error-callback restructuring; not a kernel project change."
    },
    {
      "name": "mempool",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/txmempool.cpp (+1/-1) and src/txmempool.h (+1/-1) purely as mechanical follow-up to coin view signature changes.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Trivial mechanical updates to mempool coin view lookups with no change to policy or mempool mechanics."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Test files updated (test/functional/feature_coinsdb_read_error.py, coins_tests.cpp, fuzz harnesses) specifically test the database error handling change rather than test runner/harness infrastructure.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "Test changes accompany and pin the validation and dbwrapper changes rather than modifying shared test infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "CDBWrapper (src/dbwrapper) is explicitly defined as validation database infrastructure rather than general utilities.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Changes to CDBWrapper and fatal error handling for database reads fall under validation storage rather than generic node utilities."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Labeled 'UTXO Db and Indexes' and heavily modifies src/coins.*, src/txdb.*, src/dbwrapper.*, and chainstate error propagation.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.7,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Fixes an issue where typed deserialization errors in CDBWrapper::Read() returned false, causing corrupted data to masquerade as missing keys, while LevelDB read errors threw without running error callbacks. It also removes the CCoinsViewErrorCatcher indirection layer, substantially simplifying the coins view stack."
    }
  ],
  "factors": {
    "security_stability": 2,
    "bug_severity": 2,
    "performance": 0,
    "user_value": 0,
    "leverage": 1
  }
}
